key_insight: Multiscale FFT accelerates random-allocation privacy accounting, improving accuracy-dependent runtime from O(α⁻²) to O(α⁻¹ log(1/α)) while preserving the accountant’s guarantees.
engineering_relevance: Faster high-accuracy privacy accounting can make random-allocation DP-SGD and communication-efficient aggregation more practical.
method: Represent likelihood ratios on grids that are uniform within each dyadic interval.
Use interval-wise FFTs to compute the exact rounding of every pairwise sum.
Apply mean-preserving connect-the-dots projection to reduce rounding errors in mean privacy loss and χ² divergence to O(α²/log(t)).
evidence_signal: Experiments report speedups of several orders of magnitude at high accuracy and improved privacy bounds for DP-SGD with PREAMBLE.
watch_item: The abstract does not specify benchmark sizes or hardware, so practical speedups require validation on the intended workload.
paper_title: Fast Privacy Loss Accounting for Random Allocation via Multiscale FFT
